text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—How have things been going since then, 
Nakayama-san?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"You mean that item? ...Heh, no worries. 
It'll arrive soon."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Much obliged. My little sister seems to 
have taken a liking to it, so I really 
wanted to get my hands on it for her.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, acting like it doesn't concern you. I 
know the truth. You love it too, don't 
you? —*That* thing.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oops... looks like I've been spotted.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I can tell. The way your eyes look at 
"that"... You've got the fierce glare of a 
gambler right before a big bet.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... What incredible competitive 
intuition.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well then, please let me know once it 
arrives. I will come pick it up.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Right back atcha. You better have an 
interesting match ready for me, got it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—...Still, to think you guys would like my 
hometown's chazuke that much... Heh.
